entities.name: Rostov-on-Don pre-trial detention center hostage crisis
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: On 16 June 2024, a hostage situation occurred at a detention center in Rostov-on-Don, Rostov Oblast, Russia. The hostage takers, all Islamic State militants who were previously detained at the center, were shot and killed except one militant captured alive, two employees were rescued.
